title: DP-PreCo-GRL: code, data and raw results for Preference-Conditioned Graph Reinforcement Learning for Energy-, Carbon- and Risk-Aware Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling with Fuzzy Processing Times
description: Simulator, baselines (dispatching rules, PWG, NSGA-II/III), preference-conditioned graph policy, PPO trainer, analysis scripts, trained checkpoints and per-run objective vectors of the manuscript.
